## Objective
- Adapt the existing shooter for Android landscape play with on-screen touch controls.

## Requirements
- Apply the change without asking clarifying questions.
- Validate at a viewport no wider than 1280px, save a small JPEG screenshot, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Show a rotate-device prompt in portrait orientation and use a coarse-pointer landscape layout for touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile landscape and portrait CSS rules and touch-control markup in `index.html`.
- Added touch movement, aiming, match setup/pause handling, movement-pad input, pointer handlers, touch actions, held-fire updates, and touch-layout syncing in `src/main.js`.
- Validated an active match at 960×540 with emulated touch: all touch buttons fit within the viewport and touch controls appear.
- Moved the minimap to the upper-left in landscape and hid the extra equipment HUD to avoid overlap with touch controls.
- Saved and inspected the latest JPEG screenshot: `artifacts/android-landscape-touch.jpg`.
- `node --check src/main.js` and `git diff --check` passed previously.

1. If further changes are needed, revalidate the touch layout and refresh `artifacts/android-landscape-touch.jpg`.

- `index.html`: Mobile styles, touch-control markup, portrait rotate prompt, and landscape HUD positioning.
- `src/main.js`: Gameplay and touch-input handling.
- `artifacts/android-landscape-touch.jpg`: Latest 960×540 touch-emulated screenshot.
- `touch-validation.html`: Browser validation harness.
